verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Revenue is a state tax agency portal for filing, paying, and licensing. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is outside what this kind of product offers. Amended returns and Request for Change forms are corrections to tax filings, not automation version control, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
